question: Which syllables and formula constitute the heart-nyāsa of this mantra?
premises: The sequence yauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ is given
The formula ends with obeisance to the heart
inference: The heart-nyāsa is formed by yauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ namo hṛdayāya namaḥ
plain_english: Say yauṃ, nauṃ, mauṃ, nama, aiṃ, namo hṛdayāya namaḥ; this is the heart.
